import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    start_hist = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

    oi = db["order_items"]
    orders = db["orders"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # --- История продаж: только заказы, уже совершённые до seed_time ---
    oi_hist = oi[(oi["ts"] >= start_hist) & (oi["ts"] < seed_time)].copy()

    cols_orders = [
        "order_id",
        "order_status",
        "order_purchase_timestamp",
        "order_delivered_carrier_date",
        "order_delivered_customer_date",
        "order_estimated_delivery_date",
    ]
    oi_orders = oi_hist.merge(orders[cols_orders], on="order_id", how="left")

    # Информация о доставке известна на момент seed_time только если
    # событие уже произошло (дата <= seed_time)
    delivered_known = (
        oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] <= seed_time)
    )
    carrier_known = (
        oi_orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna()
        & (oi_orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"] <= seed_time)
    )

    # Доставка до клиента (в днях), известна только для доставленных заказов
    oi_orders["delivery_days"] = np.where(
        delivered_known,
        (oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"]
         - oi_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan,
    )
    # Опоздание относительно оценки
    oi_orders["delivery_delay_days"] = np.where(
        delivered_known,
        (oi_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"]
         - oi_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan,
    )
    oi_orders["days_purchase_to_carrier"] = np.where(
        carrier_known,
        (oi_orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"]
         - oi_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan,
    )
    # Разница между оценкой и покупкой — известна сразу после покупки
    oi_orders["estimated_delivery_days"] = (
        oi_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        - oi_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    # Статус, наблюдаемый на момент seed_time
    def observed_status(row_status, delivered, carrier):
        if delivered:
            return "delivered"
        if carrier:
            return "shipped"
        return row_status if pd.notna(row_status) else "unknown"

    oi_orders["observed_status"] = [
        observed_status(s, d, c)
        for s, d, c in zip(
            oi_orders["order_status"],
            delivered_known,
            carrier_known,
        )
    ]
    oi_orders["is_delivered_known"] = delivered_known.astype(np.float64)
    oi_orders["is_canceled_or_unavailable"] = (
        oi_orders["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"]).astype(np.float64)
    )

    # --- Отзывы: известны только те, что созданы до seed_time ---
    rev_known = reviews[
        (reviews["review_creation_date"] >= start_hist - pd.Timedelta(days=30))
        & (reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time)
    ][["order_id", "review_score"]]
    rev_known = rev_known.groupby("order_id", as_index=False)["review_score"].mean()

    oi_full = oi_orders.merge(rev_known, on="order_id", how="left")

    # --- Платежи: агрегаты известны на момент покупки заказа (ts < seed_time) ---
    pay_agg = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        max_installments=("payment_installments", "max"),
        n_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
    ).reset_index()
    oi_full = oi_full.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    oi_full["credit_card"] = None
    pt = payments.merge(
        oi_hist[["order_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    pt_frac = (
        pt.assign(is_cc=(pt["payment_type"] == "credit_card").astype(np.float64))
        .groupby("order_id")["is_cc"].mean()
        .rename("frac_credit_card_order")
        .reset_index()
    )
    oi_full = oi_full.merge(pt_frac, on="order_id", how="left")

    # --- Признаки активности товара в разных временных окнах ---
    ts_all = oi[["order_id", "product_id", "ts", "price", "freight_value"]]

    def window_feats(days):
        t0 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        w = ts_all[(ts_all["ts"] >= t0) & (ts_all["ts"] < seed_time)]
        g = w.groupby("product_id").agg(
            units=(("order_id"), "count"),
            revenue=("price", "sum"),
            n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        )
        g.columns = [f"units_{days}d", f"revenue_{days}d", f"n_orders_{days}d"]
        return g

    feat_30 = window_feats(30)
    feat_90 = window_feats(90)
    feat_180 = window_feats(180)
    feat_365 = window_feats(365)

    # Активность в прошлом (до окна истории) — для давности/тренда
    before = ts_all[ts_all["ts"] < start_hist].groupby("product_id").agg(
        units_before=("price", "count"),
        last_sale_before=("ts", "max"),
    )

    agg = oi_full.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        max_price=("price", "max"),
        min_price=("min_price",) if False else ("price", "min"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        avg_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "mean"),
        max_delivery_days=("delivery_days", "max"),
        avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
        max_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "max"),
        frac_late_deliveries=(
            "delivery_delay_days",
            lambda x: (x > 0).mean() if x.notna().any() else 0.0,
        ),
        avg_purchase_to_carrier=("days_purchase_to_carrier", "mean"),
        avg_estimated_delivery_days=("estimated_delivery_days", "mean"),
        frac_delivered=("is_delivered_known", "mean"),
        frac_canceled=("is_canceled_or_unavailable", "mean"),
        frac_shipped=(
            "observed_status",
            lambda x: (x == "shipped").mean(),
        ),
        n_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        n_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        frac_reviews=("review_score", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        frac_5star=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 5).mean()),
        frac_1star=("review_score", lambda x: (x == 1).mean()),
        avg_order_total=("total_payment", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("avg_installments", "mean"),
        max_installments=("max_installments", "max"),
        avg_n_payments=("n_payments", "mean"),
        avg_frac_cc=("frac_credit_card_order", "mean"),
    )
    agg["last_sale_in_hist"] = oi_full.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
    agg["first_sale_in_hist"] = oi_full.groupby("product_id")["ts"].min()
    agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - agg["last_sale_in_hist"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
    agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - agg["first_sale_in_hist"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    out = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))
    out = out.join(agg, how="left")
    out = out.join(feat_30, how="left")
    out = out.join(feat_90, how="left")
    out = out.join(feat_180, how="left")
    out = out.join(feat_365, how="left")
    out = out.join(before, how="left")

    # Давность прошлой активности
    out["days_since_prehist_sale"] = (
        seed_time - out["last_sale_before"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0

    # Отзыв: отсутствие отзыва - не нейтральный балл, а отдельный признак frac_reviews
    out["avg_review_score"] = out["avg_review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    out["min_review_score"] = out["min_review_score"].fillna(3.0)
    out["frac_reviews"] = out["frac_reviews"].fillna(0.0)

    # Производные: тренд продаж
    out["trend_30_365"] = out["units_30d"] / (out["units_365d"] + 1.0)
    out["trend_90_365"] = out["units_90d"] / (out["units_365d"] + 1.0)
    out["is_new_product"] = (out["total_units"].isna()).astype(np.float64)
    out["has_history"] = out["total_units"].notna().astype(np.float64)
    out["repeat_rate"] = out["total_units"] / (out["n_orders"] + 1e-9)

    # Убираем временные столбцы
    out = out.drop(columns=["last_sale_in_hist", "first_sale_in_hist", "last_sale_before"],
                   errors="ignore")

    out = out.fillna(0.0)
    out = out.reindex(entity_ids)
    out = out.astype(np.float64)
    return out
